calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS ty_year, 'FY2024/25' AS ly_year, 27 AS first_week, 39 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.fiscal_year), (d.fiscal_year, cs.region))
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.stores, ty.store_weeks, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region NULLS FIRST

WITH my AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, s.store_id, SUM(x.v) AS mine, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS dt, f.store_key, f.net_amount AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, r.store_key, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  ) x JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=x.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=x.dt
  WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND s.store_id<900
  GROUP BY 1,2
), ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND r.store_id<900
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.region, cs.open_date, cs.close_date,
  a.mine AS ty_mine, a.n AS ty_n, c.ctl AS ty_ctl, b.mine AS ly_mine, b.n AS ly_n, e.ctl AS ly_ctl
FROM dim_store cs
LEFT JOIN my a ON a.store_id=cs.store_id AND a.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
LEFT JOIN my b ON b.store_id=cs.store_id AND b.fiscal_year='FY2024/25'
LEFT JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id=cs.store_id AND c.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
LEFT JOIN ctl e ON e.store_id=cs.store_id AND e.fiscal_year='FY2024/25'
WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id<900
ORDER BY cs.store_id

SELECT 'closure' AS chk, closure_id::VARCHAR AS a, store_id::VARCHAR AS b, closure_type AS c, closure_start_date::VARCHAR AS d, closure_end_date::VARCHAR AS e, weeks_closed::VARCHAR AS f FROM ref_store_closure
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_sales', COUNT(*)::VARCHAR, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id)::VARCHAR, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id::VARCHAR||'-'||line_no::VARCHAR)::VARCHAR, MIN(sale_date)::VARCHAR, MAX(sale_date)::VARCHAR, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at)::VARCHAR
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_ret', COUNT(*)::VARCHAR, COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id)::VARCHAR, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id)::VARCHAR, MIN(return_date)::VARCHAR, MAX(return_date)::VARCHAR, NULL
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'neg_or_zero', COUNT(*)::VARCHAR, SUM(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::VARCHAR, SUM(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::VARCHAR, NULL, NULL, NULL
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'

WITH g AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT store_key) AS sk, COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) AS pk,
         COUNT(DISTINCT net_amount) AS na, COUNT(DISTINCT quantity) AS q, COUNT(DISTINCT sale_ts_utc) AS ts,
         MIN(sales_line_id) AS id1, MAX(sales_line_id) AS id2, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS l1, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS l2
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT n, sk, pk, na, q, ts, COUNT(*) AS groups, MIN(l1) AS min_l1, MAX(l2) AS max_l2, MIN(id1) AS minid, MAX(id2) AS maxid FROM g GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY groups DESC

WITH r AS (
  SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no) AS n
  FROM fact_sales_line f
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, s.store_id, s.region, COUNT(*) AS dup_rows, SUM(net_amount) AS dup_net, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS loaded_min, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS loaded_max
FROM r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.sale_date
WHERE n>1 AND rn=2
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH w AS (
  SELECT r.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ns, COUNT(*) AS days_with_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN r.net_sales>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_pos
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 39 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND r.store_id<900
  GROUP BY ALL
), s AS (
  SELECT store_id, fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS weeks, MIN(ns) AS min_wk, AVG(ns) AS avg_wk, MIN(days_pos) AS min_days_pos, SUM(days_pos) AS tot_days_pos
  FROM w GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT * FROM s WHERE weeks<13 OR min_wk < 0.5*avg_wk OR min_days_pos<5 ORDER BY store_id, fiscal_year

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS ty_year, 'FY2024/25' AS ly_year, 27 AS first_week, 39 AS last_week, 3 AS fiscal_quarter
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) AS rn
        FROM fact_sales_line f
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cs.region
)
SELECT ty.region, params.ty_year AS fiscal_year, params.fiscal_quarter,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.region
